name: Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab (ddAC-TH)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed anthracycline-taxane regimen: requires HER2-positive disease (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified). HR (ER/PR) status tested to guide endocrine therapy, not the HER2 backbone. Trastuzumab must not be given concurrently with the anthracycline (cardiac toxicity); it begins with paclitaxel. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy (BINV-M).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling to prevent hypersensitivity; give before paclitaxel.

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: dose-dense (every-14-day) cycles require myeloid growth factor support per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M dosing footnote n.
Cardiac: do not overlap trastuzumab with the anthracycline (BINV-M 4 of 10 footnote h); evaluate LVEF before and during trastuzumab (every 3 months per FDA label / BINV-M 1 of 10).
monitoring: LVEF at baseline and periodically during trastuzumab (every 3 months per FDA label / BINV-M 1 of 10)

doseModificationRules.condition: significant decline in LVEF or symptomatic heart failure
doseModificationRules.text: Hold trastuzumab and obtain clinical review per LVEF monitoring guidance (BINV-M 1 of 10).

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 8 of 10. DOXOrubicin 60 mg/m2 IV day 1, every 14 days for 4 cycles (dose-dense, with growth factor support). Tall-man per ISMP. Cumulative lifetime cap is the conventional anthracycline ceiling (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2), not a dose from the breast dosing table.

provenance.locator: BINV-M 8 of 10, Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 8 of 10. Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 IV day 1, every 14 days for 4 cycles (dose-dense phase).

provenance.locator: BINV-M 8 of 10, Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 8 of 10. PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV day 1, every 14 days for 4 cycles, following completion of the AC phase. Tall-man per ISMP.

provenance.locator: BINV-M 8 of 10, Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (loading dose)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 8 of 10. Trastuzumab 4 mg/kg IV loading dose, given with the first dose of paclitaxel (NOT with the anthracycline).

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (weekly maintenance)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 8 of 10. Trastuzumab 2 mg/kg IV weekly to complete 1 year of treatment. Alternative (source-stated): trastuzumab 6 mg/kg IV every 21 days following completion of paclitaxel, to complete 1 year of trastuzumab therapy.
